name: identify-object
title: Identify an object
description: Look at an object and report its category and tags (asset annotation) once it is in the head camera view.
use_when: The category or identity of a visible object must be confirmed.

postconditions.name: identified
postconditions.meaning: The robot recorded the object's category while it was in the head camera view.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

postconditions.name: in_view
postconditions.meaning: Target point inside the head camera frustum, within 5 m, line of sight not blocked by furniture boxes.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: identified
checks.meaning: The robot recorded the object's category while it was in the head camera view.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: in_view
checks.meaning: Target point inside the head camera frustum, within 5 m, line of sight not blocked by furniture boxes.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

fallback.when: the object is not visible from here

alternative.when: the size, not the category, is needed

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
